Re-reviewed the #3158 DelegationResultDelivery paragraph against 44c41caa52: the changed clause matches record(), which now drops still-waiting unlogged-turn suppressions only for a completed, aborted or exited settlement, as CooperativeStop.applyPendingTurnInterrupt clears its pending cancel only on turn.completed, turn.aborted and session.exited; the TTL bound is unchanged (DELEGATION_RESULT_UNLOGGED_TURN_WINDOW_MS = PENDING_TURN_INTERRUPT_TTL_MS). 'Matched as the service matches its one pending interrupt (the next turn to start)' still holds: bindUnlogged() now binds every waiting suppression to that next turn so a refusal undoes only itself, which is what 'A refused interrupt undoes only its own records' already states. The BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction change makes no documented claim here.
